CSE Shariah Index revised

Dhaka, May 19, 2026: The CSE Shariah Index (CSI) has been reviewed and revised on the basis of the performance of the CSE-listed companies. The new index will be effective from 03 June 2026. CSE Shariah index (CSI) is reviewed twice a year.

 

The new 3 companies which has been included are ASIATIC LABORATORIES LIMITED, CVO PETROCHEMICAL REFINERY PLC. and SAIHAM TEXTILE MILLS LTD. On the other hand, 12 companies i.e., BANGLADESH BUILDING SYSTEMS PLC., BARAKA PATENGA POWER LTD, BARAKA POWER LIMITED, DOREEN POWER GENERATIONS AND SYSTEMS LIMITED, GRAMEENPHONE LIMITED, LEGACY FOOTWEAR LIMITED, MALEK SPINNING MILLS PLC., MJL BANGLADESH PLC,NAVANA CNG LIMITED, OLYMPIC ACCESSORIES LTD., PREMIER CEMENT MILLS PLC, and SAIHAM COTTON MILLS LTD. were excluded from the previous list. 

 

In the revised CSE Shariah Index, 103 listed companies out of 383 listed Companies have been selected. These are- AAMRA NETWORKS LIMITED, AAMRA TECHNOLOGIES LTD., ACME PESTICIDES LTD., ADN TELECOM LIMITED, ADVENT PHARMA LIMITED, AGNI SYSTEMS PLC., AL-ARAFAH ISLAMI BANK PLC., ALIF INDUSTRIES LIMITED, AMAN COTTON FIBROUS PLC., AMBEE PHARMACEUTICALS PLC, ANWAR GALVANIZING LIMITED, APEX FOODS LIMITED, APEX SPINNING & KNITTING MILLS LTD., ASIATIC LABORATORIES LIMITED, BANGAS LIMITED, BANGLADESH EXPORT IMPORT COMPANY LTD., BATA SHOE COMPANY (BD) LIMITED, BBS CABLES PLC., BD.THAI ALUMINIUM LIMITED, BEACH HATCHERY  LTD., BENGAL WINDSOR THERMOPLASTICS PLC., BERGER PAINTS BANGLADESH LTD, BEXIMCO PHARMACEUTICALS PLC., CENTRAL PHARMACEUTICALS LIMITED, COPPERTECH INDUSTRIES LTD., CVO PETROCHEMICAL REFINERY PLC., DAFFODIL COMPUTERS PLC., DOMINAGE STEEL BUILDING SYSTEMS LTD, DRAGON SWEATER AND SPINNING LIMITED, EASTERN CABLES LIMITED, EGENERATION PLC., ESQUIRE KNIT COMPOSITE PLC, FAR CHEMICAL INDUSTRIES LTD., FAR EAST KNITTING & DYEING INDUSTRIES PLC., FAREAST ISLAMI LIFE INSURANCE COMPANY LTD, FINE FOODS LIMITED, FORTUNE SHOES LIMITED, FU-WANG FOODS LIMITED, GLOBAL HEAVY CHEMICALS LIMITED, GQ BALL PEN INDUSTRIES LIMITED, HAKKANI PULP & PAPER MILLS PLC., HAMID FABRICS PLC, HEIDELBERG MATERIALS BANGLADESH PLC., HWA WELL TEXTILES (BD) PLC., INDEX AGRO INDUSTRIES LTD, INDO-BANGLA PHARMACEUTICALS LTD., INTRACO REFUELING STATION LTD., ISLAMI BANK BANGLADESH PLC., ISLAMI INSURANCE BANGLADESH LTD., ISLAMIC FINANCE&INVESTMENT PLC.,IT CONSULTANTS PLC., JMI HOSPITAL REQUISITE MFG.
